source: FUNSD (guillaumejaume.github.io/FUNSD), test split read through the nielsr/funsd mirror on Hugging Face. Real scanned forms (1990s tobacco-industry faxes and cover sheets from RVL-CDIP).
license: FUNSD is offered for non-commercial research and educational use (see the dataset page); its images come from RVL-CDIP (https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~aharley/rvl-cdip/). Used here only to test the reader, in a free tool, like the repo's CC BY-NC invoice set.
changes: 3 of the 50 test forms. Word boxes re-laid-out into lines; person names replaced with [name removed]. Empty blanks (SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS, JUDGE, TRIAL DATE) are proposed with a null value: the form leaves them to fill, so the field list shows them as blanks for a person or Jev to fill, never invented. The second phone line of funsd-test-14 ("PHONE: 202/ 828- 2259 and ...") is proposed as phone_2. funsd-test-7/16 were added in a later stress pass: a dense two-column memo form with checkbox rows and a multi-recipient fax cover. The account/recipient tables in both are proposed as fields only where a label sits next to a value; the table cells themselves stay for a person or Jev to check.
